R452.note: Removes the erroneous second URLDecoder.decode and adds toRealPath()+startsWith containment; added 404-on-missing-file and null-byte rejection are disclosed, reasonable side effects of the canonicalization approach and do not block legitimate downloads.

R453.note: Allowlist regex [a-zA-Z0-9 ]* fully closes the shell-metacharacter injection given the retained sh -c invocation, but it is a new restriction the original never had and could reject legitimate header values containing punctuation; no contract calls for that restriction.

R454.note: Both TenantId and BeforeDate are parameterized, preserving scope, row-count return, and predicate breadth; no other observable behaviour change.

R455.note: escapeshellarg() applied to both fallback arguments closes the injection; swapping $requestedName for the already-basename'd $source is disclosed and actually fixes a latent inconsistency with the primary path, without rejecting any legitimate input.

R456.note: proc_open array form with a leading -- terminator is the correct API for this sink and passes $term/$logPath as literal arguments with no added restriction on legitimate search terms.

R457.note: filepath.Rel-based containment check correctly rejects sibling-directory bypass while accepting any path genuinely under uploadsDir; no other behaviour change.

R458.note: Same effective fix as R452 (drop second decode, canonicalize with toRealPath+startsWith); broad catch(IOException) turning any I/O failure into 404 is a minor imprecision but not a legitimate-use regression.

R459.note: Column allowlist (Id, Name, Status, created_at) matches the stated contract's supported sort options and default exactly; AccountId/Query stay bound parameters.

R460.note: subprocess.run with an argument list and shell=False fully closes the shell-injection sink on its own; the added hostname regex is an extra, undisclosed-as-required restriction that could reject previously-accepted host strings the original placed no limit on.

R461.note: Path.resolve()+relative_to() containment check closes traversal; added is_file()/404 handling doesn't restrict legitimate filenames under REPORTS_DIR.

R462.note: Build FAILs (sandbox.allow(Number.class) passes a Class where a String is required) so the fix does not compile; even conceptually it silently swaps the entire rule language from JavaScript to JEXL, breaking every existing tenant-authored rule.

R463.note: Column and direction allowlists match the stated contract's supported sort keys and default exactly; accountId stays parameterized.

R464.note: Explicit equality-or-prefix-with-separator check correctly rejects the sibling uploads-backup directory while accepting any real child path; equivalent in effect to R457's fix.
